<?php

namespace Illuminate\Support;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Arrayable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Htmlable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Jsonable;
use JsonSerializable;
use Stringable;

class Js implements Htmlable, Stringable
{
    /**
     * The JavaScript string.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $js;

    /**
     * Flags that should be used when encoding to JSON.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected const REQUIRED_FLAGS = JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR;

    /**
     * Create a new class instance.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int|null  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return void
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public function __construct($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        $this->js = $this->convertDataToJavaScriptExpression($data, $flags, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new JavaScript string from the given data.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return static
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public static function from($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        return new static($data, $flags, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given data to a JavaScript expression.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    protected function convertDataToJavaScriptExpression($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        if ($data instanceof self) {
            return $data->toHtml();
        }

        $data = enum_value($data);

        $encodingFlags = $flags;
        $hexTagFlag = JSON_HEX_TAG;
        $hexAposFlag = JSON_HEX_APOS;
        $hexAmpFlag = JSON_HEX_AMP;
        $hexQuotFlag = JSON_HEX_QUOT;
        $throwOnErrorFlag = JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR;

        if (($encodingFlags & $hexTagFlag) !== $hexTagFlag) {
            $encodingFlags |= $hexTagFlag;
        }

        if (($encodingFlags & $hexAposFlag) !== $hexAposFlag) {
            $encodingFlags |= $hexAposFlag;
        }

        if (($encodingFlags & $hexAmpFlag) !== $hexAmpFlag) {
            $encodingFlags |= $hexAmpFlag;
        }

        if (($encodingFlags & $hexQuotFlag) !== $hexQuotFlag) {
            $encodingFlags |= $hexQuotFlag;
        }

        if (($encodingFlags & $throwOnErrorFlag) !== $throwOnErrorFlag) {
            $encodingFlags |= $throwOnErrorFlag;
        }

        $json = null;
        $emptyJsonArray = '[]';
        $emptyJsonObject = '{}';

        if ($data instanceof Collection) {
            $serializedItems = [];
            $collectionItems = $data->all();

            foreach ($collectionItems as $collectionItem) {
                if ($collectionItem instanceof JsonSerializable) {
                    $serializedValue = $collectionItem->jsonSerialize();
                    $serializedItems[] = $serializedValue;
                } else {
                    if ($collectionItem instanceof Jsonable) {
                        $jsonablePayload = $collectionItem->toJson();
                        $decodedPayload = json_decode($jsonablePayload, true);
                        $serializedItems[] = $decodedPayload;
                    } else {
                        if ($collectionItem instanceof Arrayable) {
                            $arrayPayload = $collectionItem->toArray();
                            $serializedItems[] = $arrayPayload;
                        } else {
                            $serializedItems[] = $collectionItem;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            $json = json_encode($serializedItems, $encodingFlags);
        } else {
            if ($data instanceof LazyCollection) {
                $serializedItems = [];
                $lazyItems = $data->all();

                foreach ($lazyItems as $lazyItem) {
                    if ($lazyItem instanceof JsonSerializable) {
                        $serializedValue = $lazyItem->jsonSerialize();
                        $serializedItems[] = $serializedValue;
                    } else {
                        if ($lazyItem instanceof Jsonable) {
                            $jsonablePayload = $lazyItem->toJson();
                            $decodedPayload = json_decode($jsonablePayload, true);
                            $serializedItems[] = $decodedPayload;
                        } else {
                            if ($lazyItem instanceof Arrayable) {
                                $arrayPayload = $lazyItem->toArray();
                                $serializedItems[] = $arrayPayload;
                            } else {
                                $serializedItems[] = $lazyItem;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                $json = json_encode($serializedItems, $encodingFlags);
            } else {
                if ($data instanceof Jsonable) {
                    $jsonableFlags = $encodingFlags;
                    $json = $data->toJson($jsonableFlags);
                } else {
                    $payload = $data;

                    if ($payload instanceof Arrayable) {
                        if (! ($payload instanceof JsonSerializable)) {
                            $payload = $payload->toArray();
                        }
                    }

                    $json = json_encode($payload, $encodingFlags, $depth);
                }
            }
        }

        if (is_string($data)) {
            $quotedJson = substr($json, 1, -1);

            return "'".$quotedJson."'";
        }

        if ($json === $emptyJsonArray) {
            return $json;
        }

        if ($json === $emptyJsonObject) {
            return $json;
        }

        $useJsonParse = false;
        $jsonStringPrefix = '"';
        $jsonObjectPrefix = '{';
        $jsonArrayPrefix = '[';

        if (Str::startsWith($json, $jsonStringPrefix)) {
            $useJsonParse = true;
        } else {
            if (Str::startsWith($json, $jsonObjectPrefix)) {
                $useJsonParse = true;
            } else {
                if (Str::startsWith($json, $jsonArrayPrefix)) {
                    $useJsonParse = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if ($useJsonParse) {
            $encodedJson = json_encode($json, $encodingFlags);
            $unquotedJson = substr($encodedJson, 1, -1);

            return "JSON.parse('".$unquotedJson."')";
        }

        return $json;
    }

    /**
     * Encode the given data as JSON.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public static function encode($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        if ($data instanceof Jsonable) {
            return $data->toJson($flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS);
        }

        if ($data instanceof Arrayable && ! ($data instanceof JsonSerializable)) {
            $data = $data->toArray();
        }

        return json_encode($data, $flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given JSON to a JavaScript expression.
     *
     * @param  string  $json
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    protected function convertJsonToJavaScriptExpression($json, $flags = 0)
    {
        if ($json === '[]' || $json === '{}') {
            return $json;
        }

        if (Str::startsWith($json, ['"', '{', '['])) {
            return "JSON.parse('".substr(json_encode($json, $flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS), 1, -1)."')";
        }

        return $json;
    }

    /**
     * Get the string representation of the data for use in HTML.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function toHtml()
    {
        return $this->js;
    }

    /**
     * Get the string representation of the data for use in HTML.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function __toString()
    {
        return $this->toHtml();
    }
}

part.text:
The `SupportNumberTest` errors are pre-existing (they occur on the clean tree too, unrelated to this change). The fix is complete.

**Fix** (`src/Illuminate/Support/functions.php:46`): `enum_value()` used `empty($value)` as an early return, but `empty()` is always `false` for objects — so an empty collection fell through to `transform()`, which treats blank values as "no value" and returned the `$default` (`null`). That `null` then hit `Js`'s final `json_encode()` branch, producing `'null'`. Replacing `empty()` with `blank()` (which correctly detects empty `Countable` objects) returns the collection as-is, so `Js::from()` serializes it through its `Collection`/`LazyCollection` branches.

Verified:
- `Js::from([])`, `Js::from(new Collection)`, `Js::from(LazyCollection::empty())` → `[]`
- Enums, `null`, scalars, and non-empty collections behave as before
- `SupportJsTest` + `SupportEnumValueFunctionTest`: 22 tests, 36 assertions, all pass
